column1: # v1: reviewed semantic identity policy, not a naming heuristic at runtime.
# Every real database column must match this resource and its SQL type family.
# PLAYER is an active or queryable player reference. Business IDs and historical operation keys remain byte-for-byte stable.
# MILESTONE, PLAYER_LIST, PLAYER_SCOPE, ROLE_SUBJECT and DUNGEON_EVENT have explicit typed transformations.
# OPAQUE_ASSET requires an adapter unless the engine recognizes immutable terminal history.
# HISTORY retains original evidence; VALUE is unchanged and rejects unclassified embedded source/target UUIDs.
# MIGRATION_AUDIT is immutable operational evidence, never a runtime identity alias.
